chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v01] Then the existence of the circle is briefly described: having established the eastern direction, one stretches the thread uniformly.

[tal-a31-v10] We say that yoni mandala, shown by the order of true being; in the four-handed Veda-supported form, abandon three parts all around.

[tal-a31-v02] Having halved that, one marks again in middle, east, and west; then by half-of-half measure, east and west.

[tal-a31-v03] By that much one marks; with thread one gives the twin compass; the fish-joint pair thus becomes in south and north.

[tal-a31-v04] In its middle one drops the thread for south-north success; or, with an east-west equal thread, north-south.

[tal-a31-v05] One marks from the other mark and from the east too; likewise those are placed in the fish middle, throwing a long thread south-north.

[tal-a31-v06] By the measured field's half measure, from the middle one marks toward directions; with two threads arising from two directions, the fish becomes corner-placed.

[tal-a31-v07] In the fishes, the Vedas are threads; thus a square is proclaimed, from one onward, as a hundred-ending mandala.

[tal-a31-v08] In the Siddhanta tantra, a hundred mandalas are called that seat; what goes in its middle, the chief three mandalas, is remembered.

[tal-a31-v09] Middle trident, triple trident, and nine trident are clear; there the trident arrangement is said with infinite divisions.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C31 atha śrītantrāloke ekatriṃśamāhnikam atha maṇḍalasadbhāvaḥ saṃkṣepeṇābhidhīyate / sādhayitvā diśaṃ pūrvāṃ sūtramāsphālayetsamam tadardhayitvā madhyaprākpratīcīṣvaṅkayetpunaḥ / tato@pyardhatadardhārdhamānataḥ pūrvapaścimau aṅkayettāvatā dadyāt sūtreṇa bhramayugmakam / matsyasandhidvayaṃ tvevaṃ dakṣiṇottarayorbhavet tanmadhye pātayetsūtraṃ dakṣiṇottarasiddhaye / yadi vā prākparāktulyasūtreṇottaradakṣiṇe aṅkayedaparādaṅkāt pūrvādapi tathaiva te / matsyamadhye kṣipetsūtramāyataṃ dakṣiṇottare matakṣetrārdhamānena madhyāddikṣvaṅkayettataḥ / sūtrābhyāṃ digdvayotthābhyāṃ matsyaḥ syātpratikoṇagaḥ matsyeṣu vedāḥ sūtrāṇītyevaṃ syāccaturasrakam / ekasmātprabhṛti proktaṃ śatāntaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yataḥ siddhātantre maṇḍalānāṃ śataṃ tatpīṭha ucyate / yattanmadhyagataṃ mukhyaṃ maṇḍalānāṃ trayaṃ smṛtam madhyaśūlaṃ tritriśūlaṃ navaśūlamiti sphuṭam / tatra śūlavidhānaṃ yaduktaṃ bhedairanantakaiḥ tadyoni maṇḍalaṃ brūmaḥ sadbhāvakramadarśitam / vedāśrite caturhaste tribhāgaṃ sarvatastyajet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v11] Divide all each field by sixteen parts; then the middle of two brahma threads is clearly the brahma place.

[tal-a31-v12] Having made a boundary, then the target is the fourth thread from the beginning; then go transversely to the fourth thread thereafter.

[tal-a31-v13] In the square, if there are two moons, make the outer half-part; their attached brahma-sutra is situated at the third marman.

[tal-a31-v14] If so, in the half of the square, the inward-facing pair would be at the second marman of the hand, immovable.

[tal-a31-v15] Having made a pair of full moons, the wise one should turn them from the sixth brahma-sutra point to the third cross part.

[tal-a31-v16] Having made a half-square, rotate the thread hanging from the full moon tip, upward-facing, toward the broken-moon pair fire part.

[tal-a31-v17] Having abandoned the cross-part pair, from the western broken moon then to the corner, so it would be; make a broken piece with two rotations.

[tal-a31-v18] From that one very sharp curved tip a horn is born; the same rule is declared for the second; this rule is clear.

[tal-a31-v19] When the middle horn is to be made, in the third upper square and fourth half, an inward-facing pair of moon-halves would be.

[tal-a31-v20] And that one full moon, previously turned, should reach as needed; by mutual knot union a bound state arises.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ sarvaṃ tattatkṣetraṃ vibhājayet / brahmasūtradvayasyātha madhyaṃ brahmapadaṃ sphuṭam kṛtvāvadhiṃ tato lakṣyaṃ caturthaṃ sūtramāditaḥ / tatastiryagvrajet sūtraṃ caturthaṃ tadanantare koṣṭhe cendudvayaṃ kuryādbahirbhāgārdhabhāgataḥ / tayorlagnaṃ brahmasūtrāttṛtīye marmaṇi sthitam koṣṭhakārdhe@paraṃ ceti yugmamantarmukhaṃ bhavet / brahmasūtrāddvitīyasmin haste marmaṇi niścalam kṛtvā pūrṇenduyugalaṃ vartayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ / brahmasūtragatāt ṣaṣṭhāt tiryagbhāgāttṛtīyake kṛtvārdhakoṣṭhake sūtraṃ pūrṇacandrāgralambitam / bhramayedunmukhaṃ khaṇḍacandrayugvahnibhāgagam tiryagbhāgadvayaṃ tyaktvā khaṇḍendoḥ paścimāttataḥ / koṇaṃ yāvattathā syācca kuryāt khaṇḍaṃ bhramadvayam sutīkṣṇakuṭilāgraṃ tadekaṃ śṛṅgaṃ prajāyate / dvitīyasminnapi proktaḥ śṛṅga eṣa vidhiḥ sphuṭaḥ madhyaśṛṅge@tha kartavye tṛtīye ūrdhvakoṣṭhake / caturthārdhe ca candrārdhadvayamantarmukhaṃ bhavet tacca pūrṇendumekaṃ prāgvartitaṃ prāpnuyādyathā / anyonyagranthiyogena baddhāratvaṃ prajāyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v21] Thus on the second side, from turning the broken-moon pair, the joined cheek-knot should be led forward by the other two middles.

[tal-a31-v22] The thread in both sides, by which it becomes sharp and goes to the middle horn, has the second brahma-sutra behind at the bottom of both sides.

[tal-a31-v23] With attention it should be grasped by the teacher who knows the ritual; the mantra-knower would be rear-facing in that brahma-sutra.

[tal-a31-v24] Having excluded the middle horn, all the previously stated rule then applies to the upward-facing broken-moon pair previously declared.

[tal-a31-v25] Then, by two, the gandika well fitted inside, by two front threads, the middle horn pair becomes.

[tal-a31-v26] Below, by increase of its part, the lotus has four circles; then the wheel is sixteen-spoked or twelve-spoked, in two ways.

[tal-a31-v27] In the middle, the place of Kuleshvari may be space, or tilaka, or lotus, or a six-spoked wheel, or a twelvefold space.

[tal-a31-v28] At the trident, seven-spoked, by mere joining from the middle, of lotuses then wheels or spaces, seven becomes.

[tal-a31-v29] Mixed or confused by difference of contraction and expansion; then by half-measure of field, one should throw the field there with extra measure.

[tal-a31-v30] There the staff is remembered: a part of six-spoked pure essence, very sharp-tipped, red-glowing, causing instant possession.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-evaṃ dvitīyapārśve@sya khaṇḍendudvayavartanāt / madhyābhyāṃ gaṇḍikā śliṣṭā parābhyāmagrato nayet sūtraṃ pārśvadvaye yena tīkṣṇaṃ syānmadhyaśṛṅgagam / pārśvadvayādhare paścādbrahmasūtraṃ dvitīyakam avadhānena saṃgrāhyamācāryeṇohavedinā / bhavetpaścānmukho mantrī tasmiṃśca brahmasūtrake madhyaśṛṅgaṃ varjayitvā sarvaḥ pūrvodito vidhiḥ / tato yadunmukhaṃ khaṇḍacandrayugmaṃ puroditam tato dvayena kartavyā gaṇḍikāntaḥsusaṃgatā / dvayenāgragasūtrābhyāṃ madhyaśṛṅgadvayaṃ bhavet adho bhāgavivṛddhyāsya padmaṃ vṛttacatuṣṭayam / tataścakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ dvidhātha tat madhye kuleśvarīsthānaṃ vyoma vā tilakaṃ ca vā / padmaṃ vātha ṣaḍaraṃ vā viyaddvādaśakaṃ ca vā tritriśūle@tra saptāre śliṣṭamātreṇa madhyataḥ / padmānāmatha cakrāṇāṃ vyomnāṃ vā saptakaṃ bhavet miśritaṃ vātha saṃkīrṇaṃ samāsavyāsabhedataḥ / tataḥ kṣetrārdhamānena kṣetraṃ tatrādhikaṃ kṣipet tatra daṇḍaḥ smṛto bhāgaḥ ṣaḍarāmalasārakaḥ / sutīkṣṇāgraḥ suraktābhaḥ kṣaṇādāveśakārakaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v31] That goddess Kundalini, called wave and great-wave-possessing, is situated in the kanda called six-cornered and is six-deity-natured.

[tal-a31-v32] Spread out and long by eight parts, from half of that; then doors should be made in order by variegated turning.

[tal-a31-v33] Forms resting on the Vedas, or merely circular, or with clear horn, one should make, or in reverse order.

[tal-a31-v34] Having broken the upward-facing or moon-pair, make four; crooked in the middle, clear downward-facing, situated at the side.

[tal-a31-v35] Upright, half-equal, full, joined, and knot-placed; thus the moon's turning is twelvefold and delusion-breaking.

[tal-a31-v36] By inward and outward facing, she is again considered twofold; from those divisions of circles there would be countless expansion of divisions.

[tal-a31-v37] The mandala's lines vary through the blending of beauty and adornment.

[tal-a31-v38] The circles become countless through variations of existence and nonexistence.

[tal-a31-v39] Then powders are given according to beauty: vermilion, lapis, and white chalk.

[tal-a31-v40] Excellent powders here arise through union of three deities.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yā sā kuṇḍalinī devī taraṅgākhyā mahormiṇī / sā ṣaḍaśreṇa kandākhye sthitā ṣaḍdevatātmikā aṣṭabhāgaiśca vistīrṇo dīrghaścāpi tadardhataḥ / tato dvārāṇi kāryāṇi citravartanayā kramāt vedāśrāyatarūpāṇi yadivā vṛttamātrataḥ / spaṣṭaśṛṅgamatho kuryādyadivā vaiparītyataḥ unmukhaṃ candrayugmaṃ vā bhaṅktvā kuryāccatuṣṭayam / kuṭilo madhyataḥ spaṣṭo@dhomukhaḥ pārśvagaḥ sthitaḥ uttāno@rdho@samaḥ pūrṇaḥ śliṣṭo granthigatastathā / candrasyetthaṃ dvādaśadhā vartanā bhramabhedinī antarbahirmukhatvena sā punardvividhā matā / tadbhedānmaṇḍalānāṃ syādasaṅkhyo bhedavistaraḥ pīṭhavīthībahiarbhūmikaṇṭhakarṇakapolataḥ / śobhopaśobhāsaṃbhedādguṇarekhāvikalpataḥ svastikadvitayādyaṣṭatayāparyantabhedataḥ / bhāvābhāvavikalpena maṇḍalānāmanantatā tato rajāṃsi deyāni yathāśobhānusārataḥ / sindūraṃ rājavartaṃ ca khaṭikā ca sitottamā uttamāni rajāṃsīha devatātrayayogataḥ / parā candrasamaprakhyā raktā devī parāparā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v41] All goddesses dance always when they see this circle.

[tal-a31-v42] Even without worship, seeing the circle initiates one through the mothers.

[tal-a31-v43] The supreme goddess power is established as breath-bearing among the trident rites.

[tal-a31-v44] The world is established in this coil through principles and their goddesses.

[tal-a31-v45] Three trident-piercing powers sit above as seat, accomplishing enjoyment and liberation.

[tal-a31-v46] Therefore one desiring liberation worships this great rite with great splendor.

[tal-a31-v47] By merely seeing this circle, spirits, vetalas, and guhyakas flee.

[tal-a31-v48] Even one weak in power pleases Shiva directly through worship of this circle.

[tal-a31-v49] Always by six months one attains trika knowledge, having obtained and considered by oneself what is to be rejected and accepted.

[tal-a31-v50] At the end of the body one becomes Bhairava-self; one desiring siddhi succeeds in this mandala through pervasion and deity placement.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-aparā sā parā kālī bhīṣaṇā caṇḍayoginī / dṛṣṭvaitanmaṇḍalaṃ devyaḥ sarvā nṛtyanti sarvadā anarcite@pyadīkṣeṇa dṛṣṭe dīkṣyeta mātṛbhiḥ / kiṃvātibahunoktena tritriśūlārasaptakāḥ śūlayāgāḥ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇyevaṃ sārdhaśatadvayam / yā sā devī parā śaktiḥ prāṇavāhā vyavasthitā viśvāntaḥ kuṇḍalākārā sā sākṣādatra vartitā / tattvāni tattvadevyaśca viśvamasminpratiṣṭhitam atrordhve tantumātreṇa tisraḥ śūlāragāḥ sthitāḥ / āsanatvena cecchādyā bhogamokṣaprasādhikāḥ tāstu mokṣaikakāmasya śūlārāviddhamadhyakāḥ / tasmādenaṃ mahāyāgaṃ mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ pūjayedbhūtikāmo vā mokṣakāmo@pivā budhaḥ / asya darśanamātreṇa bhūtavetālaguhyakāḥ palāyante daśa diśaḥ śivaḥ sākṣātprasīdati / mandaśaktibalāviddho@pyetanmaṇḍalapūjanāt satataṃ māsaṣaṭkena trikajñānaṃ samaśnute / yatprāpya heyopādeyaṃ svayameva vicārya saḥ dehānte syādbhairavātmā siddhikāmo@tha siddhyati / maṇḍalasyāsya yo vyāptiṃ devatānyāsameva ca

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v51] He knows conduct as guru in trika teaching; his foot-dust is to be borne on the head by one desiring Shiva.

[tal-a31-v52] Here worship creation, preservation, and destruction in order; the fourth, however, is all-filling from the middle, or in all.

[tal-a31-v53] Or perform the four-trident or hidden-staff sacrifice; there worship that fourfold sequence properly and clearly.

[tal-a31-v54] Thus this was told in the secret supreme sixfold heart, declared and indicated in Siddhayogishvari-mata.

[tal-a31-v55] Having threaded the mandala in front, it grants all desires, equipped with great trident and adorned with lotus wheel.

[tal-a31-v56] At each gate draw a trident, excluding the western; or in corners make a great trident with tree.

[tal-a31-v57] At the trident tip place trika; thus it is to be made eightfold, or threefold.

[tal-a31-v58] Thus the divine city of sky-goers is indicated; it is told in Siddha-tantra teaching, even in another place.

[tal-a31-v59] Lotus-born in the middle, with trident peaks by its half; the trident-marked mandala is to be constructed, and lotus-marked in filling.

[tal-a31-v60] Now the trident-lotus arrangement is in Shripurva, Trishira-mata, Siddha-tantra, Trikakula, and Devi-yamala-mala.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-vartanāṃ ca vijānāti sa gurustrikaśāsane / tasya pādarajo mūrdhni dhāryaṃ śivasamīhinā atra sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsān kramāt trīnapi pūjayet / turyaṃ tu madhyato yadvā sarveṣu paripūrakam catustriśūlaṃ vā guptadaṇḍaṃ yāgaṃ samācaret / tatra tat pūjayetsamyak sphuṭaṃ kramacatuṣṭayam ityetatkathitaṃ gupte ṣaḍardhahṛdaye pare / ṣaṭke proktaṃ sūcitaṃ śrīsiddhayogīśvarīmate agrataḥ sūtrayitvā tu maṇḍalaṃ sarvakāmadam / mahāśūlasamopetaṃ padmacakrādibhūṣitam dvāre dvāre likhecchūlaṃ varjayitvā tu paścimam / koṇeṣvapica vā kāryaṃ mahāśūlaṃ drumānvitam amṛtāmbhobhavārīṇāṃ śūlāgre tu trikaṃ trikam / śūla itthaṃ prakartavyamaṣṭadhā tat tridhāpivā evaṃ saṃsūcitaṃ divyaṃ khecarīṇāṃ puraṃ tviti / sthānāntare@pi kathitaṃ śrīsiddhātantraśāsane kajaṃ madhye tadardhena śūlaśṛṅgāṇi tāni tu / śūlāṅkaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kalpyaṃ kamalāṅkaṃ ca pūraṇe atha śūlābjavinyāsaḥ śrīpūrve triśiromate / siddhātantre trikakule devyāyāmalamālayoḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v61] As stated in the essence treatise, the existence and secrets of tantra are shown clearly, even though the order has been stated before.

[tal-a31-v62] In the veda-supported three-hand measure, first divide the eastern half, abandoning all sides, toward east, north, and south.

[tal-a31-v63] With three-finger upward slanting eightfold cells, abandon two and two parts, then proceed again south and north.

[tal-a31-v64] From Brahma's side, from the fourth living side eastward, a half-part measure gives two moon-segment pairs.

[tal-a31-v65] In the third between them, on the south and north sides, in the living principle, the wise one makes a pair of moon segments by inner rotation.

[tal-a31-v66] At the farther vital point, reaching the tips of two moon segments, one makes an outward-facing rotation and two moon-segment pairs.

[tal-a31-v67] Similarly in Brahma, one does the part and half-part measure, then at the end of the second part on both sides.

[tal-a31-v68] Two eastern-going lines are led by wise ones in third-part equality to the tip of the half-moon above, joined to Brahma's thread tip.

[tal-a31-v69] One should make two threads for establishing the middle peak; one thread is held in one interval from the living side of that tip.

[tal-a31-v70] Bring to the corner end from the corner of the first and second moon segments, and from the farther living side and the corner of the first half-moon.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yathoktaḥ sāraśāstre ca tantrasadbhāvaguhyayoḥ / tathā pradarśyate spaṣṭaṃ yadyapyuktakramādgataḥ vedāśrite trihaste prāk pūrvamardha vibhājayet / hastārdhaṃ sarvatastyaktvā pūrvodagyāmyadiggatam tryaṅgulaiḥ koṣṭhakairūrdhvaistiryak cāṣṭadvidhātmakaiḥ / dvau dvau bhāgau parityajya punardakṣiṇasaumyagau brahmaṇaḥ pārśvayorjīvāccaturthāt pūrvatastathā / bhāgārdhabhāgamānaṃ tu khaṇḍacandradvayaṃ dvayam tayorantastṛtīye tu dakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ / jīve khaṇḍenduyugalaṃ kuryādantarbhramādbudhaḥ tayoraparamarmasthaṃ khaṇḍendudvayakoṭigam / bahirmukhaṃ bhramaṃ kuryāt khaṇḍacandradvayaṃ dvayam tadvadbrahmaṇi kurvīta bhāgabhāgārdhasaṃmitam / tato dvitīyabhāgānte brahmaṇaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ dve rekhe pūrvage neye bhāgatryaṃśaśame budhaiḥ / ekārdhendūrdhvakoṭisthaṃ brahmasūtrāgrasaṅgatam sūtradvayaṃ prakurvīta madhyaśṛṅgaprasiddhaye / tadagrapārśvayorjīvāt sūtramekāntare dhṛtam ādidvitīyakhaṇḍendukoṇāt koṇāntamānayet / tayorevāparājjīvāt prathamārdhendukoṇataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v71] Just so, lead the thread for establishing two peaks; in the other half of the field there is a staff of two hands, hidden five.

[tal-a31-v72] The six-spread four-long measure, with vedic finger below it and impurity essence, has its root below; a sharp tip is desired.

[tal-a31-v73] For the first field, make four gates in the directions, measuring a cubit or half, or equal to the breadth.

[tal-a31-v74] Outside, make the lotus double; listen, make circles with single-part measures in a veda-like manner.

[tal-a31-v75] In the directions eight, and again eight, life threads; sixteen in all, drop the numbered ones in the middle of each pair.

[tal-a31-v76] Make the whirling equal to the side life in the third circle, up to this point; then measure the life tip.

[tal-a31-v77] Wherever contact is steadied in that connection, the mantra master acts there and leads the leaf tips to success.

[tal-a31-v78] In each petal make three and three filaments, double eight fingers to be made, and likewise three horns.

[tal-a31-v79] The pericarp is yellow; the filament net is made white, red, and yellow by root, middle, and tip.

[tal-a31-v80] The petals are white; with the elephant goad, the seat is likewise four-cornered, half the pericarp, outside.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tadvadeva nayetsūtraṃ śṛṅgadvitayasiddhaye / kṣetrārdhe cāpare daṇḍo dvikaraśchannapañcakaḥ ṣaḍvistṛtaṃ caturdīrghaṃ tadadho@malasārakam / vedāṅgulaṃ ca tadadho mūlaṃ tīkṣṇāgramiṣyate ādikṣetrasya kurvīta dikṣu dvāracatuṣṭayam / hastāyāmaṃ tadardhaṃ vā vistārādapi tatsamam dviguṇaṃ bāhyataḥ kuryāttataḥ padmaṃ yathā śṛṇu / ekaikabhāgamānāni kuryādvṛttāni vedavat dikṣvaṣṭau punarapyaṣṭau jīvasūtrāṇi ṣoḍaśa / dvayordvayoḥ punarmadhye tatsaṃkhyātāni pātayet eṣāṃ tṛtīyavṛttasthaṃ pārśvajīvasamaṃ bhramam / etadantaṃ prakurvīta tato jīvāgramānayet yatraiva kutracitsaṅgastatsaṃbandhe sthirīkṛte / tatra kṛtvā nayenmantrī patrāgrāṇāṃ prasiddhaye ekaikasmindale kuryātkesarāṇāṃ trayaṃ trayam / dviguṇāṣṭāṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ tadvacchṛṅgakajatrayam karṇikā pītavarṇena mūlamadhyāgrabhedataḥ / sitaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kāryaṃ kesarajālakam dalāni śuklavarṇāni prativāraṇayā saha / pīṭhaṃ tadvaccatuṣkoṇaṃ karṇikārdhasamaṃ bahiḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v81] The feet are white, red, yellow, black from fire in order; four horns, and three circles are intended.

[tal-a31-v82] The staff should be blue-red with yellow amala essence; make the red trident as previously appointed.

[tal-a31-v83] Behind the gate, in front, leaving four fingers, make the gate veda-cornered, round, mixed, or variegated.

[tal-a31-v84] The one-two-three city is equal, joined or both, and variegated with cheek, throat, beauty, adornment, and many decorations.

[tal-a31-v85] Thus it is said in the Shridevyayamala: the field has a varied arrangement and is endowed with fine vine-houses, when the veda-supported field exists.

[tal-a31-v86] Having made half twelve-fold, horizontally and vertically, the teacher should lower one horizontal portion upward from his own side.

[tal-a31-v87] That middle three-part should be rotated at its end; abandoning one portion, one should rotate again in its middle.

[tal-a31-v88] From the third part upward, rotating the upward part until the end; from the fourth part upward, but join up and down again.

[tal-a31-v89] Rotating upward from that measure, one should appoint by the fourth; the thread joins upward in order up to the brahma-thread.

[tal-a31-v90] Having made the portion by order and width, one should diminish it again; the staff is desired as double the half-portion measure.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-sitaraktapītakṛṣṇaistatpādān vahnitaḥ kramāt / caturbhirapi śṛṅgāṇi tribhirmaṇḍalamiṣyate daṇḍaḥ syānnīlaraktena pītamāmalasārakam / raktaṃ śūlaṃ prakurvīta yattatpūrvaṃ prakalpitam paścāddvārasya pūrveṇa tyaktvāṅgulacatuṣṭayam / dvāraṃ vedāśri vṛttaṃ vā saṃkīrṇaṃ vā vicitritam ekadvitripuraṃ tulyaṃ sāmudgamathavobhayam / kapolakaṇṭhaśobhopaśobhādibahucitritam vicitrākārasaṃsthānaṃ vallīsūkṣmagṛhānvitam / śrīdevyāyāmale tūktaṃ kṣetre vedāśrite sati ardhaṃ dvādaśadhā kṛtvā tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca tiryajam / bhāgamekaṃ svapārśvordhvaṃ guruḥ samavatārayet madhyasthaṃ taṃ tribhāgaṃ ca tadante bhramayedubhau / bhāgamekaṃ parityajya tanmadhye bhramayetpunaḥ tṛtīyāṃśordhvato bhrāmyamūrdhvāṃśaṃ yāvadantataḥ / caturthāṃśāttadūrdhvaṃ tu ūrdhvādho yojayetpunaḥ tanmānādūrdhvamābhrāmya caturthena niyojayet / ūrdhvādyojayate sūtraṃ brahmasūtrāvadhi kramāt kramādvaipulyataḥ kṛtvā aṃśaṃ vai hrāsayet punaḥ / ardhabhāgapramāṇastu daṇḍo dviguṇa iṣyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v100] This sacrifice is called the Damara three-powered sacrifice; then the trident-lotus rite is described in Trishira.

[tal-a31-v91] Taking portion by portion from both ranges, the rotating leaf becomes downward like a pippala leaf.

[tal-a31-v92] In the sixteenth part one should draw a lotus; by twelve-angula reduction, above that in the middle portion one should draw the lotus-birth well.

[tal-a31-v93] At the end of the middle horn, one should draw the third; likewise here on right and left, one should draw well in the hip lotus.

[tal-a31-v94] The pericarp is yellowish; the filament is red, yellow, and white; and the petals placed outside the lotus are white, as counter-obstacle.

[tal-a31-v95] The trident is black powder; the brahma-line is white; the trident-tip is joined by flame; and the trident staff is yellowish.

[tal-a31-v96] In the middle of the trident, in that lotus, the wise one should always worship the lord; above it the supreme, on the right, and another on the left.

[tal-a31-v97] That goddess, beyond supreme time, established as time's end, always devours the trident wheel by mere will.

[tal-a31-v98] This power is peace-form and knowledge-form supreme; but foundation is lower, and cessation is both supreme and lower.

[tal-a31-v99] The upward-standing Bhairava staff has Sada-Shiva nature; its four powers are gross and subtle in many ways.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ gṛhītvā tu ubhayoratha gocarāt / bhrāmyaṃ pippalavat patraṃ vartanaiṣā tvadho bhavet ṣoḍaśāṃśe likhetpadmaṃ dvādaśāṅgulalopanāt / tadūrdhvaṃ madhyabhāge tu vārijanma samālikhet madhyaśṛṅgāvasāne tu tṛtīyaṃ vilikhettataḥ / savyāsavye tathaiveha kaṭisthābje samālikhet karṇikā pītalā raktapītaśuklaṃ ca kesaram / dalāni padmabāhyasthā śuklā ca prativāraṇī śūlaṃ kṛṣṇena rajasā brahmarekhā sitā punaḥ / śūlāgraṃ jvālayā yuktaṃ śūladaṇḍastu pītalaḥ śūlamadhye ca yatpadmaṃ tatreśaṃ pūjayetsadā / asyordhve tu parāṃ dakṣe@nyāṃ vāme cāparāṃ budhaḥ yā sā kālāntakā devī parātītā vyavasthitā / grasate śūlacakraṃ sā tvicchāmātreṇa sarvadā śāntirūpā kalā hyeṣā vidyārūpā parā bhavet / aparā tu pratiṣṭhā syānnivṛttistu parāparā bhairavaṃ daṇḍa ūrdhvasthaṃ rūpaṃ sādāśivātmakam / catasraḥ śaktayastvasya sthūlāḥ sūkṣmāstvanekadhā eṣa yāgaḥ samākhyāto ḍāmarākhyastriśaktikaḥ / atha traiśirase śūlābjavidhirdṛṣṭo@bhilikhyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v101] With principal purifiers such as left nectar, pleasing and purifying, worship the ground, dust, instrument, and chalk from the root.

[tal-a31-v102] In a square four-cubit space, place the trident in the middle; it has three hands, fierce form, two cubits, and a large up-down seat pair.

[tal-a31-v103] The staff, eight fingers and with three threads, is to be made; at the staff root, the seat is twelve fingers.

[tal-a31-v104] Upward from length and height, by four-finger measure; upward from height, four fingers; from length, ten fingers.

[tal-a31-v105] Having made the trident-root seat in the middle measured by space-ocean-equal fingers, make the staff a trident divided into three parts all around.

[tal-a31-v106] By eight-finger measure all around, the trident tip would be hand-measure; the middle and root become accordingly.

[tal-a31-v107] The altar is to be made in the middle; at both sides it is six fingers and twelve fingers long.

[tal-a31-v108] From four-finger height at the root, arrange the altar; at both sides it is thus half-moon shaped.

[tal-a31-v109] Rotate the chalk thread around the waist, making it two fingers wide and four fingers long by measure, O goddess.

[tal-a31-v110] Arrange the left side likewise as the right side, with one finger width from the trident tip in the middle, below and above.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-vāmāmṛtādibhirmukhyaiḥ pavitraiḥ sumanoramaiḥ / bhūmiṃ rajāṃsi karaṇīṃ khaṭikāṃ mūlato@rcayet caturaśre caturhaste madhye śūlaṃ karatrayam / caṇḍo dvihasta ūrdhvādhaḥpīṭhayugvipulastvasau vasvaṅgulaḥ prakartavyaḥ sūtratrayasamanvitaḥ / dvādaśāṅgulamānena daṇḍamūle tu pīṭhikā dairghyāttūcchrāyāccordhve ca caturaṅgulamānataḥ / ūrdhve@pyucchrāyato vedāṅgulā dairghyāddaśāṅgulā śūlamūlagataṃ pīṭhīmadhyaṃ khābdhisamāṅgulam / kṛtvā daṇḍaṃ triśūlaṃ tu tribhirbhāgaiḥ samantataḥ aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇaiḥ syāddhastamātraṃ samantataḥ / śūlāgraṃ śūlamadhyaṃ tacchūlamūlaṃ tu tadbhavet vedī madhye prakartavyā ubhayośca ṣaḍaṅgulam / dvādaśāṅguladīrghā tu ubhayoḥ pārśvayostathā caturaṅgulamucchrāyānmūle vedīṃ prakalpayet / ubhayoḥ pārśvayoścaivamardhacandrākṛtiṃ tathā bhrāmayet khaṭikāsūtraṃ kaṭiṃ kuryāddviraṅgulām / vaipulyāddairghyato devi caturaṅgulamānataḥ yādṛśaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge vāme tadvatprakalpayet / madhye śūlāgravaipulyādaṅgulaśca adhordhvataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v111] By four-finger measure from width, six fingers from height, then the gaṇḍikā should be made by its own form.

[tal-a31-v112] Above the base, O good-vowed one, the trident base should be made; the trident tip should be made one finger, very sharp, six fingers.

[tal-a31-v113] The hub middle should be made; below the hub, six fingers, four fingers deep, and the middle should be arranged.

[tal-a31-v114] East-west, that trident in the middle; outside that, make with three threads, turning them one by one.

[tal-a31-v115] Three lotuses at the trident tip, twelve fingers by Veda parts, in order right, middle, left, with three, eight, and twelve petals.

[tal-a31-v116] Three wheels, wind city, an eight-finger lotus called vidyā at the trident base; scatter powder afterward.

[tal-a31-v117] Fill the trident up to the staff with rājavarta; on the back of the three threads, three white lines should be.

[tal-a31-v118] With white powder at the trident base, the vidyā lotus should be; upward in order, three lotuses are red, red-black, white.

[tal-a31-v119] The sky line should be white, one finger thick; leaving that outside, the platform should be made hand measure by measure.

[tal-a31-v120] The wall should be square, three times the width from length; then all around, in directions, doors should be hand measure.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-caturaṅgulamānena vaipulyāttu ṣaḍaṅgulā / ucchrāyāttu tataḥ kāryā gaṇḍikā tu svarūpataḥ pīṭhordhve tu prakartavyaṃ śūlamūlaṃ tu suvrate / śūlāgramaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ sutīkṣṇaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulam arāmadhyaṃ prakartavyamarādhastu ṣaḍaṅgulam / caturaṅgulanimnaṃ tu madhyaṃ tu parikalpayet pūrvāparaṃ tadeveha madhye śūlaṃ tu tadbahiḥ / kārayeta tribhiḥ sūtrairekaikaṃ vartayeta ca kajatrayaṃ tu śūlāgraṃ vedāṃśairdvādaśāṅgulam / kramāddakṣānyamadhyeṣu tryaṣṭadvādaśapatrakam cakratrayaṃ vātapuraṃ padmamaṣṭāṅgulārakam / vidyābhikhyaṃ śūlamūle rajaḥ paścātprapātayet triśūlaṃ daṇḍaparyantaṃ rājavartena pūrayet / sūtratrayasya pṛṣṭhe tu śuklaṃ cārātrayaṃ bhavet śuklena rajasā śūlamūle vidyāmbujaṃ bhavet / raktaṃ raktāsitaṃ śuklaṃ kramādūrdhvāmbujatrayam śuklena vyomarekhā syāt sā sthaulyādaṅgulaṃ bahiḥ / tāṃ tyaktvā vedikā kāryā hastamātraṃ pramāṇātaḥ vaipulyatriguṇaṃ dairghyāt prākāraṃ caturaśrakam / samantato@tha dikṣu syurdvārāṇi karamātrataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v121] Divide the twelve-angula measure gradually into three parts: neck, cheek, beauty, and ornament at the end.

[tal-a31-v122] Then make a square wall furnished with lines, using white, red, yellow, and black powders.

[tal-a31-v123] Fill the middle with red powders as befits beauty, and follow there what was said earlier about its pervasion.

[tal-a31-v124] Night-day division, entry, exit, rotation, pervasion of the anahata place, and the supreme rise of kundali are listed.

[tal-a31-v125] The trident goddesses are in the heart place; the trident staff stands at the navel; the trident root is situated in the heart.

[tal-a31-v126] Remember the three wheels at the end, lifting repeatedly by kala from the form of the body's middle.

[tal-a31-v127] Having traversed the trident staff and trident middle-end ranges, enter root, middle, and end into the shakti abode at the final end.

[tal-a31-v128] After making non-pulsation, once turning pulsation and pressing root bliss, one should enter the place of the three shaktis.

[tal-a31-v129] There, with effortful worship, all siddhis arise from union of all paths and from sixfold path pervasion.

[tal-a31-v130] With effort of all mantra wheels and so on, one should contemplate the trident made of thirty-six tattvas.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tridhā vibhajya kramaśo dvādaśāṅgulamānataḥ / kaṇṭhaṃ kapolaṃ śobhāṃ tu upaśobhāṃ tadantataḥ prākāraṃ caturaśraṃ tu sabhūrekhāsamanvitam / sitaraktapītakṛṣṇai rajobhiḥ kārayettataḥ raktai rajobhirmadhyaṃ tu yathāśobhaṃ tu pūrayet / asyā vyāptau purā coktaṃ tatraivānusarecca tat arātrayavibhāgastu praveśo nirgamo bhramaḥ / anāhatapadavyāptiḥ kuṇḍalyā udayaḥ paraḥ hṛdi sthāne gatā devyastriśūlasya sumadhyame / nābhisthaḥ śūladaṇḍastu śūlamūlaṃ hṛdi sthitam śaktisthānagataṃ prāntaṃ prānte cakratrayaṃ smaret / utkṣipyotkṣipya kalayā dehamadhyasvarūpataḥ śūladaṇḍāntamadhyasthaśūlamadhyāntagocaram / praviśenmūlamadhyāntaṃ prāntānte śaktiveśmani aspandakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ekadā spandavartanam / mūlamānandamāpīḍya śaktitrayapadaṃ viśet tatra pūjyaṃ prayatnena jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥ / samastādhvasamāyogāt ṣoḍhādhvavyāptibhāvataḥ samastamantracakrādyairevamādiprayatnataḥ / ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaracitaṃ triśūlaṃ paribhāvayet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v131] At equinox, place the mantras in the supreme mandala; when this is worshipped, one attains the place of the all-lord.

[tal-a31-v132] With svastika the fitting rite is to be done; place the channels first, according to muhurta measure.

[tal-a31-v133] Twenty-nine lineages are located in the indra, varuna, south, and north directions, going straight and transverse.

[tal-a31-v134] Eight hundred forty-one marman points arise by lineages and sense counts in the lotus circle.

[tal-a31-v135] By taste counts the seat becomes a svastika giving all desires; by vasu counts the door paths are arranged.

[tal-a31-v136] Destroy the holes, brahmin, arrow, and fire points, outer and inner, in order, in four directions and middle doors, O beautiful one.

[tal-a31-v137] In cities of fire, earth, sage, sky, outer, and womb, destroy marman points devoid of inner channels.

[tal-a31-v138] In door and wall corners, channels of brahma lineage situated from eye and taste, including eye, fire, arrow, and seasons, are to be destroyed.

[tal-a31-v139] Destroy fire and eye-fire; vedas and eye-pair from taste; the moon-going eye; and east vedas fire from taste.

[tal-a31-v140] Abandoning the world-located small channel, eye vedas fires follow in order; also the arrow fire-going pair and eye fires from taste.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-viṣuvatsthena vinyāso mantrāṇāṃ maṇḍalottame / kāryo@smin pūjite yatra sarveśvarapadaṃ bhajet svastikenātha kartavyaṃ yuktaṃ tasyocyate vidhiḥ / nāḍikāḥ sthāpayetpūrvaṃ muhūrtaṃ parimāṇataḥ śakravāruṇadiksthāśca yāmyasaumyagatāstathā / ekonatriṃśadvaṃśāḥ syurṛjutiryaggatāstathā aṣṭau marmaśatānyekacatvāriṃśacca jāyate / vaṃśairviṣayasaṃkhyaiśca padmaṃ yugmendumaṇḍalam rasasaṃkhyairbhavetpīṭhaṃ svastikaṃ sarvakāmadam / vasusaṃkhyairdvāravīthāvevaṃ bhāgaparikramaḥ randhravipraśarāgnīṃśca lupyedbāhyāntaraṃ kramāt / marmāṇi ca caturdikṣu madhyāddvāreṣu sundari vahnibhūtamunivyomabāhyagarbhe purīṣu ca / lopayeccaiva marmāṇi antarnāḍivivarjitān dvāraprākārakoṇeṣu netrānalaśarānṛtūn / nāḍayo brahmavaṃśasya lopyā netrādrasasthitāḥ vahnernetrānalau lopyau vedānnetrayugaṃ rasāt / netraṃ saumyagataṃ lopyaṃ pūrvādvedānalau rasāt lokasthā nāḍikā hitvā netrādvedāgnayaḥ kramāt / śarairvahnigataṃ caiva yugaṃ netrāgnayo rasāt

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v141] From the eye, the east-going is named sumeru door; svastika and pleasant city are located in four directions, both.

[tal-a31-v142] Two hundred marman points, directions multiplied by sages, and eye-beginning parts are swept from the path middle, O beautiful one.

[tal-a31-v143] Made by three sages in the middle, by senses the pericarp becomes; eye-made vasus, petal, and eye are once divided.

[tal-a31-v144] Having made fire vasu-going, destroy moon-located points; in fires and sage middle, destroy up to seat and moon.

[tal-a31-v145] It speaks of removing brahman's eye-objects and omitting a small eye among eastward channels in the ocean.

[tal-a31-v146] It directs omission in the four corners of the seat from the head and eye triad.

[tal-a31-v147] Petals are white, filaments red and yellow, the pericarp gold-like, and leaf tips red.

[tal-a31-v148] The sky line is very white, and the seat is endowed with three lines: white, red, and yellow.

[tal-a31-v149] Four-colored swastikas lie toward fire and northeast; a coral-like path and weapons are outside.

[tal-a31-v150] It describes a sapphire-like thunderbolt, power, lotus-gem radiance, a gold-like staff, and a very red face.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-netrāt pūrvagatāccaiva sumerurdvārasaṃjñitaḥ / svastikā ca purī ramyā caturdikṣu sthitāvubhau marmaṇāṃ ca śate dve ca ṛṣibhirguṇitā diśaḥ / netrādikāṃśca saṃmārjya mārgamadhyāt suśobhane ṛṣitrayakṛte madhye viṣayaiḥ karṇikā bhavet / netrīkṛtānvasūn patraṃ netraṃ sakṛdvibhājitam vahniṃ vasugataṃ kṛtvā śaśāṅkasthāṃśca lopayet / vahnīṣuṛṣimadhyācca lopyaṃ pīṭhendukāvadhi brahmaṇo netraviṣayānnetrādvedānalau haret / sāgare netrakaṃ lopyaṃ nāḍayaḥ pūrvadiggatāḥ bhūtanetragatānmūrdhnā netrāddvivahnidṛktrikāt / saumyagāt pīṭhakoṇeṣu lopayeta caturṣvapi dalāni kāryāṇi sitaiḥ kesaraṃ raktapītalaiḥ / karṇikā kanakaprakhyā pallavāntāśca lohitāḥ vyomarekhā tu susitā vartulābjāntanīlabhāḥ / pīṭhaṃ rekhātrayopetaṃ sitalohitapītalam svastikāśca caturvarṇā agnerīśānagocarāḥ / vīthī vidrumasaṃkāśā svadikṣvastrāṇi bāhyataḥ indranīlanibhaṃ vajraṃ śaktiṃ padmamaṇiprabhām / daṇḍaṃ hāṭakasaṃkāśaṃ vaktraṃ tasyātilohitam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v151] A blue-radiant sword, a calf-shining noose, and a banner adorned with flowers, fruits, and five colors are described.

[tal-a31-v152] The mace is gold-like, fierce, and gem-adorned; the trident is blue-lotus-like with a blazing fiery crest.

[tal-a31-v153] Above it is a white lotus and a gold-like wheel with radiant beryl-like spokes.

[tal-a31-v154] The temple of the god of gods has a very yellow spoke-middle and flame-red outer part, granting all desired fruits.

[tal-a31-v155] The trident rite is first performed in a square field of hand measure, divided in three ways.

[tal-a31-v156] The middle part is divided in three ways with nine cells, and then this rite is described.

[tal-a31-v157] After leaving three middle parts, rotate the thread below so that a crescent-moon shape results.

[tal-a31-v158] Rotate from both sides so a shape arises at the tip, then draw the former line there with the thread.

[tal-a31-v159] Leaving four fingers by the previous far gate, the wise one destroys the line so a trident shape results.

[tal-a31-v160] Leaving half a hand at the trident tip, make lotuses below, with three horns and a lotus with pericarp in the middle of the hand.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-nīladyutisamaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ vatsakasaprabham / dhvajaṃ puṣpaphalopetaṃ pañcaraṅgaiśca śobhitam gadā hemanibhātyugrā nānāratnavibhūṣitā / śūlaṃ nīlāmbujasamaṃ jvaladvahnyugraśekharam tasyopari sitaṃ padmamīṣatpītāruṇaprabham / cakraṃ hemanibhaṃ dīptamarā vaiḍūryasaṃnibhāḥ arāmadhyaṃ supītaṃ ca bāhyaṃ jvālāruṇaṃ bhavet / mandiraṃ devadevasya sarvakāmaphalapradam śrīsiddhāyāṃ śūlavidhiḥ prāk kṣetre caturaśrite / hastamātraṃ tridhā sūryānnavakhaṇḍaṃ yathā bhavet madhye śūlaṃ ca tatretthaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ tridhā bhajet / navabhiḥ koṣṭhakairyuktaṃ tato@yaṃ vidhirucyate madhyabhāgatrayaṃ tyaktvā madhye bhāgadvayasya tu / adhastādbhrāmayetsūtraṃ śaśāṅkaśakalākṛti ubhayato bhrāmayettatra yathāgre hākṛtirbhavet / koṭyāṃ tatra kṛtaṃ sūtraṃ nayedrekhāṃ tu pūrvikām aparadvārapūrveṇa tyaktvāṅgulacatuṣṭayam / rekhāṃ vināśayetprājño yathā śūlākṛtirbhavet śūlāgre tvardhahastena tyaktvā padmāni kārayet / adhaḥ śṛṅgatrayaṃ hastamadhye padmaṃ sakarṇikam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a31-v161] Hold the thread at the mouth tip, drop it in the middle with three hands, then make two fingers below.

[tal-a31-v162] Drop two lines so a trident forms; from the lower parts upward, the line reaches there.

[tal-a31-v163] Having equalized the threads, place two upward; the middle lotus is to be established below the trident, O glorious one.

[tal-a31-v164] Thus this mandala rite has been spoken in concise form by the great teachers.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-mukhāgre dhārayetsūtraṃ tribhirhastaistu pātayet / madhye cordhvaṃ tataḥ kuryādadhastādaṅguladvayam rekhādvayaṃ pātayeta yathā śūlaṃ bhavatyapi / adhobhāgādibhiścordhvaṃ tatra rekhā prapadyate samīkṛtya tataḥ sūtre ūrdhve dve evameva tu / madhyaṃ padmaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ śūlādhastādyaśasvini ityeṣa maṇḍalavidhiḥ kathitaḥ saṃkṣepayogato mahāgurubhiḥ / [AbhT_31.164]
